dedupe_keys.name: coupling a lattice boltzmann solver to openfast for real time aeroelastic wind farm large eddy simulation

description: Queen’s University Belfast researchers publish numerical curves and performance tables for coupling a lattice-Boltzmann flow solver to OpenFAST. Zenodo provides documented CSV files, including one compressed wake-plane matrix, free under CC BY 4.0. Outputs cover NREL five-megawatt turbine loads, normalised wakes, grid convergence, coupling costs and strong or weak scaling on LUMI-G hardware. These values can benchmark aeroelastic wind-farm simulations and compare computational budgets. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this coupling-results package. Coverage is the study’s numerical cases, including a 126-metre rotor, not field observations. Reference curves from other publications, raw solver outputs, configuration files and analysis code are deliberately excluded. A limitation is that performance depends on the stated hardware and coupling settings. No CSV was downloaded, solver installed or numerical accuracy independently tested.
